title: Multiplying Larger Numbers By One-Digit Numbers

sections.normalized_html:
We write it this way:

[MATH: 4|3|5|3|2; ×|7|24and1 + 24 = 2500000]

First, we multiply the ones:

[MATH: _(1); 4|3|5|3|2; ×|7; 4|2 × 7 = 1400000000000000000; Carry:1; Write:4]

Next, we multiply the tens:

[MATH: _(2)|_(1); 4|3|5|3|2; ×|7; 2|4|3 × 7 = 21and1 + 21 = 22; Carry:2; Write:2]

Next, we multiply the hundreds:

[MATH: _(3)|_(2)|_(1); 4|3|5|3|2; ×|7; 7|2|4|5 × 7 = 35and2 + 35 = 37; Carry:3; Write:7]

Next, we multiply the thousands:

[MATH: _(2)|_(3)|_(2)|_(1); 4|3|5|3|2; ×|7; 4|7|2|4|3 × 7 = 21and3 + 21 = 24; Carry:2; Write:4]

Finally, we multiply the ten thousands:

[MATH: _(2)|_(3)|_(2)|_(1); 4|3|5|3|2; ×|7; 3|0|4|7|2|4|4 × 7 = 28and2 + 28 = 30; Carry:−; Write:30]

Therefore, [MATH: 43,532 \times 7 = 304 , 724.]
